name: Nayuta Roen
source:
Hometown: Ingrid
Occupation: Temple Knight
Weapon: Spear

Leader of the knights who protect the temple in Ingrid.
Serious and pious he's a devout believer in Ingrid's god, his life is guided by the commandments of the Ingrid temple.
